title: Octopuses Have 3 Hearts, and One Stops When They Swim #shorts
description:
An octopus has three hearts, and the main one stops beating every time it swims. That's why octopuses would rather crawl! Add blue blood and arms that can taste, and nature gets ridiculous.

A new mind-blowing fact every day. Subscribe so you never miss one!
